summary: Fixed a race where a pending sender-stats request from a stopped screen-share track could hold a global busy flag and prevent diagnostics from sampling a newly published track. Stats request locks are now scoped to track generations, so stale completion cannot block or unlock the current generation.

checks.name: Test-first check before implementation
checks.observation: The focused test failed to compile because the generation-scoped gate did not exist yet. This is the expected test-first failure, not a physical reproduction of the pending WebRTC request race.

checks.name: Generation gate tests
checks.observation: Both regressions pass: a new generation can sample while an old request is pending, and late release from the old generation cannot clear the current generation's lock.
